question: In which year was the Asiatic Cheetah declared extinct in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1952**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1952 cheetahs were declared extinct in India. 
 
• The last cheetah died in the country in 1947 and **the species was declared extinct in 1952.**
